manifest.name: dsh-simple-wiki-memory
manifest.description: DSWM — Simple Wiki Memory for DeepSeek Harness: a self-maintaining persistent memory system (index + reference/pending/archive + git backup + memory skills).
manifest.author: rainow

bundle.text:
# dsh-simple-wiki-memory (DSWM) bundle patch.
# Applied automatically when the package is installed (package.json declares
# `dsh.bundle.patch`). The node half runs in the host process and on startup:
#   - syncs the AGENTS.md six-rule skeleton into ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md (merge-only),
#   - scaffolds ~/.dsh/workspace/{reference,pending,archive}/ + memory-log.md,
#   - git-inits the workspace for backup/rollback,
#   - auto-commits memory changes after turns,
#   - reports pending (unconfirmed) memory at the start of a user turn.
#
# Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/dsh-simple-wiki-memory
- insert:
    - id: dswm
      name: dsh-simple-wiki-memory

readme.section: DSWM — DeepSeek Harness 简易 Wiki 记忆插件
readme.text:
> 也给 **OpenClaw** 用：同仓库 [openclaw/](https://github.com/rainow/dsh-simple-wiki-memory/tree/master/openclaw) 是纯文本版——规则 + 目录约定，无插件、无 hook，装法见它的 README。

超级简化版 llm-wiki 记忆插件，三层各司其职：

**① 索引** 一份文档，每个会话自动加载 · **② 主题** 每个 topic 一个 md，任务相关时才 read · **③ 技能** 每个 skill 一个 md（与 skill 同名），调用该 skill 时自动读

所以**索引既不随记忆变多、也不随工具变多而膨胀**。纯 Markdown + git，安装卸载都没有压力，想怎么改就怎么改。

readme.section: DSWM — DeepSeek Harness 简易 Wiki 记忆插件
readme.text:
基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）原生 `dsh-agent-instructions`（AGENTS.md）机制的自维护持久记忆系统。无 RAG、无向量库、无运行时 LLM 调用。

> 当前版本 **v0.4.0**（2026-11-05）· [更新记录](#更新记录) · English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)

**0.2.0 之后改了什么**（如果你上次装的是 0.2.0）：给**每个技能**加一个 md 文档，记录它的偏好与踩坑——与 skill 同名，调这个 skill 时自动读，索引不膨胀；规则从六条升到七条（写入判据 / 出错即回报 / 记录规范 / 安全红线）。**0.4.0 起归属判据改为「读它的那一刻你在干什么」**：调用工具时用的 → `skills/`，改造 / 升级 / 排障时读的 → `reference/`。已适配 DSH **0.2.2-rc.1**。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-simple-wiki-memory
```

装完即用。首次启动自动同步 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`、创建 `~/.dsh/workspace/` 并 git init——**幂等、只合并、绝不覆盖**你已有的索引条目。

三句最常用的话：

| 你说 | 它做 |
|---|---|
| （任何时候）记住… | 写进 `pending/`，下次会话开头提醒你 |
| **"存档 / 确认"** | 把待确认草稿晋升为正式记忆 + 更新索引 |
| **"整理记忆"** | 输出重组方案（拆分 / 合并 / 归档），你确认后执行 |

工具细节也照此办理：说"记住我常点的套餐 code"，它会落到 `reference/skills/`，而不是塞进索引。

每个会话第一个请求前，DSH 自动注入 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`（索引 + 规则）。DSWM 维护它和一个小型 wiki 库：

```
~/.dsh/
├── AGENTS.md              # ① 索引 + 七条规则（每会话自动注入）
└── workspace/             # 记忆库（git 仓库）
    ├── reference/         # ② 主题记忆（进索引、参与检索）

**三处分工**：

| 放哪 | 存什么 | 何时读 | 进索引 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md` 索引 | 一句话主题 + 完整路径 | 每个会话 | — |
| `reference/<主题>.md` | 跨工具的偏好与事实（口味、住址、称呼） | 索引命中时 | ✅ |
| `reference/skills/<工具>.md` | 某 skill / MCP 的稳定事实（ID、枚举、端点、必填参数）与坑点 | 用该工具前按名字查 | ❌ |
例：麦当劳 MCP 的门店 `storeCode`、套餐 `code`、取餐方式枚举 → `skills/mcp-mcd.md`；"我不吃香菜" → `reference/`。

规则全文在 `AGENTS.md` 里（每个会话都注入给 agent），这里只做速览：

| # | 规则 | 一句话 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 写入触发 | 产生即写 `pending/`，不等会话结束、不默默丢弃 |
| 2 | 准入流程 | 先定归属 → 落 pending → 你说"存档"才晋升；技能记忆另有四道闸 |
| 3 | 无人值守 | 定时任务 / 后台 subagent 只写 pending，也不得改 AGENTS.md |
| 4 | 定期整理 | "整理记忆" → 拆分 / 合并 / 归档，你确认后执行；含预算巡检与 SKILL.md 去重 |
| 5 | 备份 | `workspace/` 是 git 仓库，记忆变更后自动 commit |
| 6 | 检索 | 用工具前先查 `skills/` → 再查索引 → 最后扫目录兜底 |
| 7 | 出错即回报 | 记忆与实际不符：先标 `❓待核实` **绝不静默改数**，报你确认后再改 |
配套的**记录规范**（v0.3.0）：删除测试（"删掉它下次会出错吗"）、三类禁写（schema 已声明 / 能现场查到 / 会变的）、预算（技能记忆 6KB/80 行、reference 12KB、索引条目 80 字）、超预算需你批准；**安全红线**：永不写入凭据与无关的个人安全细节。

- 已用 DSH **0.2.2-rc.1**（next 频道最新）实测：源码对照 + 官方兼容性判定函数 + 冒烟测试全通过；兼容 0.1.0-rc.7 起全部 0.1.x / 0.2.x 发布线（含 0.2.1-rc.x、0.2.2-rc.1 与 0.2.2-alpha）。
- 0.2.2 的两处变化不影响本插件：`agent/pre-step` 载荷**追加** `modelSelection`（决策形状不变），`dsh-agent-instructions` 的字节预算改为**按链**（用户全局 / 项目）各计——本插件只用 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` 一条链，仍是 64KB。
- `engines.dsh` = `>=0.1.0-rc.7 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`。DSH 0.2+ 会据此阻止不满足要求的版本安装 / 激活；0.3.x 未声明（届时需升级 DSWM，或 `dsh plugin allow-version` 临时豁免）。
- 依赖 DSH 原生 `dsh-agent-instructions`（`dsh-base` bundle 默认启用）；部署若禁用它，记忆不会注入。

**npm（推荐，支持市场自动更新）**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-simple-wiki-memory
```

**源码安装**：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:rainow/dsh-simple-wiki-memory`

**交给 agent**：把 https://github.com/rainow/dsh-simple-wiki-memory 丢进会话，让它装。

> 指定版本要写全：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-simple-wiki-memory@0.3.0`。不写版本号时，已有的精确版本**不会**自动升级。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-simple-wiki-memory
```

停掉运行时钩子（自动 commit、pending 汇报），但**保留你的数据**：`AGENTS.md` 和 `workspace/` 都不会被删。七条规则仍留在 AGENTS.md（它只是 agent 遵循的纯文本）；想彻底移除就手动删掉那一段。

- **文件**：读写 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` 与 `~/.dsh/workspace/`（创建 `reference/`、`reference/skills/`、`pending/`、`archive/`、`memory-log.md`）
- **命令**：在 `workspace/` 内执行 `git init / add / commit`
- **无网络、无凭据、无遥测**
- 读取记忆在任何沙箱模式下都可行；写入 `workspace/` 需要 `danger-full-access`，或 `workspace-write` + 按次批准升级

- **自动 commit 不生效**：检查 `~/.dsh/workspace/.git`。git 不可用时插件优雅降级——记忆照常工作，只是没有备份
- **记忆没被注入**：确认启用了 `dsh-agent-instructions`
- **规则像是旧版**：`AGENTS.md` 顶部应有 `<!-- dswm:rules v=2 -->`。缺失时插件会在下个会话提示 agent 合并（会先强制备份 `AGENTS.md.bak-<日期>`）
- **回滚**：vault 是 git 仓库 —— `git -C ~/.dsh/workspace log` / `git -C ~/.dsh/workspace reset --hard <commit>`

```bash
node --check lib/index.js
```

包结构：`lib/index.js`（同步 + 钩子）、`assets/`（AGENTS.md / memory-log / skills-about 模板）、`skills/memory-query/`。采用 DSH bundle 分发模型（`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`）。

<details>
<summary>liangshen（梁神模式）/ Anchored Standard 下记忆不会自动加载</summary>

这两种模式会在会话首轮清空运行时上下文、只保留你的直接消息，从而**屏蔽 `dsh-agent-instructions` 对 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` 的注入**。DSWM 的索引与规则正是靠这个注入生效的，所以与会话开头不会自动加载记忆。

这不是 bug，而是锚定模式的刻意设计（用最小上下文锚定推理轨迹）。需要读写记忆时手动让 agent 读即可：

- `先读一下 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 再开始`
- 或 `按 AGENTS.md 里的记忆规则处理`
- liangshen 模式在首块锚定晋升（进入"we can"模式）后也可以手动读，之后记忆规则即按 DSWM 正常运作
- 其余会话（非锚定模式）不受影响

</details>

- **判据从「记忆里有没有专有标识符」改为「读它的那一刻你在干什么」**：调用工具时要用的事实 → `reference/skills/`；改造 / 升级 / 排障 / 讨论时读的内容 → `reference/`（DSH 插件类归顶层）。标识符降为线索。
- 原因：插件的补丁、配置项、构建坑里满是 `code` / `id` / 参数名，旧判据会把它判成技能记忆；但没人会在"调用插件"时读它，只在"改它"时读。
- 晋升 lint 从「单向 + 插件除外」改为**双向查**（`skills/` 与 `reference/` 互相可纠错）；规则 6 增补「改 / 升级 / 卸载插件前，先读索引里的插件条目，不读 `skills/`」。
- 模板与 `skills-about.md` 同步；规则标记升到 `<!-- dswm:rules v=3 -->`，已装 v2 的用户下次会话会收到一次合并提示（中英双语变更说明）。
- 兼容性不变：仍按 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 实测通过（代码只动了规则版本判定与提示文案）。

- 适配本机最新 **0.2.1-rc.4**：`session/event`+`turn/end`、`agent/pre-step` 载荷与决策形状、`createUserMessage` 来源 kind 均未变；官方兼容性判定函数在 0.1.0-rc.8 ~ 0.2.2-alpha.2 全部通过；
- `peerDependencies` 补 `^0.2.2-alpha.1` 发布线（`engines.dsh` 本就覆盖 `<0.3.0-0`）；
- 19 项端到端断言在 rc.4 的 `dsh-llm` 下重跑全过；
- README 增「0.2.0 之后改了什么」总结行（面向仍停留在 0.2.0 的用户），兼容性一节更新为 rc.4 实测。

- 开篇改为三层并列：① 索引（自动加载）② 主题（按需 read）③ 技能（与 skill 同名，调 skill 时自动读）；
- 新增「30 秒上手」置顶、「三处分工」表；七条规则压成表格；更新记录移到文末；锚定模式冲突折叠；
- 删除两张未引用的截图（1.2MB），npm 包体积降至 55KB。无代码变更。

- 规则从六分支扩为七分支：新增**技能记忆**（`reference/skills/`）、**写入前定归属**、**出错即回报**；
- 新增**记录规范**（删除测试 / 三类禁写 / 表格化 / 预算 / 超限申请）——治理记忆文件越写越啰嗦的问题；
- 新增**安全红线**（禁写凭据与无关的个人安全细节）；
- 规则区引入版本标记 `<!-- dswm:rules v=2 -->`，老用户首个会话收到中英双语**升级提示**（agent 合并 + 强制备份，插件不改用户文件）；
- `scaffoldWorkspace` 创建 `reference/skills/` 与 `_about.md`；`memory-query` 技能增加按工具检索入口；
- 本地验证：新装 / 旧版升级 / 已最新 / 漏写标记 / 缺规则区 / pending 汇报 共 19 项断言全通过。

- **适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 / 0.2.1-alpha.x / 0.2.0-rc.x，以及 0.1.6 / 0.1.7**：新增 `engines.dsh` 声明 `>=0.1.0-rc.7 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，peerDependencies 同步扩展到九条发布线；
- **重要：DSH 0.2 起会强制校验插件版本要求**——`engines.dsh`（优先）或 peerDependencies 不满足时，**会直接阻止插件安装与激活**。旧版 DSWM（≤0.1.3）在 0.2.x 上会被拦截，必须升级到本版；
- **修复 0.2 的破坏性变更**：DSH 0.2 移除了共享的 `plugin` 消息来源类型（"there is no shared catch-all `plugin` kind"），改为每个生产者通过 `MessageSourceMap` 声明自己的 kind。DSWM 现声明并使用自己的 `dswm` kind（`lib/types/index.d.ts` 含类型扩展，运行时消费者对未知 kind 自动透传）；
- 逐项对照 `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2` 源码验证：`session/event` + `turn/end`、`agent/pre-step`（agent 注入与 `{kind:'enter', messages}` 决策形状不变）、`createUserMessage`、cordis 4.0.5 `prepend`、patch `insert`、`dsh.bundle.patch` —— 全部兼容；
- 已用 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 **真实兼容性判定函数实测**：0.1.0-rc.8 ~ 0.2.1-rc.2 全部通过（0.3.x 暂不声明，届时会提示升级，可用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 临时豁免）；
- 安装/升级：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-simple-wiki-memory`。

- **适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 / 0.1.5-rc.1 / 0.1.5-alpha.x / 0.1.3-alpha.x**：peerDependencies 扩展为 `^0.1.0-rc.7 || ^0.1.1-rc.2 || ^0.1.2-alpha.1 || ^0.1.3-alpha.1 || ^0.1.5-alpha.1`，覆盖五条发布线（老版本用户不受影响）；
- 逐项对照 `dsh-v0.1.5-rc.2` 源码验证：`session/event` + `turn/end`、`agent/pre-step`（agent 注入与决策形状不变）、`createUserMessage`、cordis 4.0.2 `prepend`、patch `insert`、`dsh.bundle.patch` —— 全部兼容；
- **已确认 DSWM 不受 0.1.3/0.1.5 的破坏性变更影响**：0.1.3 的 Session persistence `SessionHandle` 重构、0.1.5 的「移除 `ctx.agent`」与 Web 插件面板 Slot 迁移，DSWM 均未使用（只用 `session/event` 与 `agent/pre-step` 两个钩子）；
- 安装/升级：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-simple-wiki-memory`。

- **适配 DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1 / 0.1.2-alpha.2**：peerDependencies 扩展为 `^0.1.0-rc.7 || ^0.1.1-rc.2 || ^0.1.2-alpha.1`，覆盖 `0.1.0-rc.7+` / `0.1.1-rc.2+` / `0.1.2-alpha.1+` 三条发布线；
- 运行时 API（`session/event`、`agent/pre-step`、消息构造、cordis patch 等）已对照 `dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.2` 源码逐项验证，**无破坏性变更**；
- 安装/升级：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-simple-wiki-memory`（npm 源自动取最新版）。

- 发布到 npm（`dsh-simple-wiki-memory`），支持 dsh-market 版本显示与自动更新；新增 GitHub Actions 自动发布（打 `v*` tag 即发布）；
- 适配 DSH 0.1.1-rc.2：peerDependencies 覆盖 `0.1.0-rc.7+` 与 `0.1.1-rc.2+`；
- README 补充与 liangshen / Anchored Standard 锚定模式的兼容性说明。

- 记忆规则系统：索引自动注入 + 每主题一个 md 按需读取；pending → reference → archive 三区 + memory-log 审计 + git 自动备份；
- 运行时钩子：回合结束自动 commit、会话开始 pending 汇报；
- AGENTS.md 只合并不覆盖，卸载保留全部数据。

readme.section: DSWM — Simple Wiki Memory for DeepSeek Harness
readme.text:
> Also works for **OpenClaw**: [openclaw/](https://github.com/rainow/dsh-simple-wiki-memory/tree/master/openclaw) is a plain-text edition — rules plus directory conventions, no plugin, no hooks.

A radically simple llm-wiki-style memory plugin with three layers, each doing one job:

readme.section: DSWM — Simple Wiki Memory for DeepSeek Harness
readme.text:
**① Index** — one document, auto-loaded into every session · **② Topics** — one markdown file per topic, read only when the task needs it · **③ Tools** — one markdown file per skill (named after the skill), read automatically when that skill is used

So the **index never grows with your memory count, and never grows with your tool count**. Plain Markdown + git — no RAG, no vector DB, no runtime LLM calls. Install and uninstall are painless; everything is editable by hand.

readme.section: DSWM — Simple Wiki Memory for DeepSeek Harness
readme.text:
Built on DSH's native `dsh-agent-instructions` (AGENTS.md) mechanism.

> Current version **v0.4.0** (2026-11-05) · [Changelog](#changelog) · 中文: [README.md](README.md)

readme.section: DSWM — Simple Wiki Memory for DeepSeek Harness
readme.text: **What changed since 0.2.0** (if you are still on 0.2.0): every skill now gets its own markdown file for its preferences and gotchas — named after the skill, read automatically when that skill is used, so the index does not grow; the rules grew from six to seven (placement test / report-on-mismatch / lean recording / secrets red line). **From 0.4.0 the placement test is "what are you doing when you read it"**: runtime facts → `skills/`, patch / upgrade / troubleshooting notes → `reference/`. Verified against DSH **0.2.2-rc.1**.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-simple-wiki-memory
```

That's it. On first startup the plugin syncs `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`, creates `~/.dsh/workspace/` and runs `git init` — idempotent, **merge-only, never overwriting** your existing index entries.

Three phrases you'll actually use:

| You say | It does |
|---|---|
| "remember …" (any time) | writes to `pending/`, reported at the start of your next session |
| **"save" / "confirm"** | promotes pending drafts into real memory + updates the index |
| **"organize memory"** | proposes a reorganisation (split / merge / archive); you approve, then it executes |

Tool details work the same way: say "remember the combo code I always order" and it lands in `reference/skills/` — not in the index.

Before the first request of every session, DSH auto-injects `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` (index + rules). DSWM maintains that file plus a small wiki vault:

```
~/.dsh/
├── AGENTS.md              # ① index + seven rules (injected into every session)
└── workspace/             # the vault (a git repo)
    ├── reference/         # ② topic memory (indexed, searchable)

**Who holds what:**

| Where | What | When read | In index |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md` index | one-line topic + full path | every session | — |
| `reference/<topic>.md` | cross-tool preferences and facts (taste, address, how you're addressed) | when an index entry matches | ✅ |
| `reference/skills/<tool>.md` | stable facts about one skill / MCP server (IDs, enums, endpoints, required params) and gotchas | right before using that tool, by name | ❌ |
Example: a food-delivery MCP's store `storeCode`, combo `code`s and pickup enums → `skills/mcp-mcd.md`; "I don't eat cilantro" → `reference/`.

readme.section: The seven rules at a glance
readme.text: The full text lives in `AGENTS.md` (injected into every session); this is just the cheat sheet:

readme.section: The seven rules at a glance
readme.text:
| # | Rule | In one line |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Write trigger | Capture as it appears → straight into `pending/`; never wait for session end |
| 2 | Admission | Classify first → `pending/` → promote only when you say "save"; per-tool memory has four extra gates |
| 3 | Unattended | Scheduled tasks / background subagents write `pending/` only and never touch AGENTS.md |
| 4 | Cleanup | "organize memory" → split / merge / archive, executed only after your approval; includes budget audit and SKILL.md de-duplication |
| 5 | Backup | `workspace/` is a git repo; auto-commit after memory changes |
| 6 | Retrieval | Before using a tool: check `skills/` → then the index → then scan the directory as a fallback |
| 7 | Report on mismatch | When memory is wrong: mark `❓unverified`, **never silently rewrite**, report to you, update after confirmation |

readme.section: The seven rules at a glance
readme.text: Backed by the **lean-recording rules** (v0.3.0): the delete test ("would removing this line cause a mistake?"), three things never to store (schema-declared / re-derivable by a query / time-varying), budgets (per-tool 6KB / 80 lines, reference 12KB, index entries 80 chars), over budget requires your approval — plus the **secrets red line**: never store credentials or unrelated personal-security details.

- Verified against DSH **0.2.2-rc.1** (latest on the `next` channel): source review + the official compatibility evaluator + smoke tests all pass; compatible with every 0.1.x / 0.2.x release line from 0.1.0-rc.7 (including 0.2.1-rc.x, 0.2.2-rc.1 and 0.2.2-alpha).
- Two 0.2.2 changes do not affect this plugin: `agent/pre-step` **adds** `modelSelection` to its payload (decision shape unchanged), and `dsh-agent-instructions` now budgets **per chain** (user-global / project) — this plugin uses only the single `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` chain, still 64KB.
- `engines.dsh` = `>=0.1.0-rc.7 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`. DSH 0.2+ uses it to block installation / activation of versions outside the range; 0.3.x is not declared yet (upgrade DSWM then, or exempt temporarily with `dsh plugin allow-version`).
- Depends on DSH's native `dsh-agent-instructions` (enabled by default in the `dsh-base` bundle); if your deployment disables it, memory will not be injected.

**npm (recommended — the market shows versions and detects updates)**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-simple-wiki-memory
```

**From source**: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:rainow/dsh-simple-wiki-memory`

**Let the agent do it**: paste https://github.com/rainow/dsh-simple-wiki-memory into a session.
> Pin a version explicitly when you need one: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-simple-wiki-memory@0.3.0`. Without a version spec, an existing exact pin is **not** upgraded automatically.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-simple-wiki-memory
```

Removing the plugin stops the runtime hooks (auto-commit, pending report) but **keeps your data**: `AGENTS.md` and `workspace/` are not deleted. The seven rules stay in AGENTS.md (plain text your agent follows); delete that section manually if you want it gone.

- **Files**: reads/writes `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` and `~/.dsh/workspace/` (creates `reference/`, `reference/skills/`, `pending/`, `archive/`, `memory-log.md`)
- **Commands**: runs `git init / add / commit` inside `workspace/`
- **No network, no credentials, no telemetry**
- Reading memory works in **any** sandbox mode; writing to `workspace/` requires `danger-full-access`, or `workspace-write` with per-call approval escalation

- **Auto-commit not happening**: check `~/.dsh/workspace/.git`. Without git the plugin degrades gracefully — memory still works, just without backup
- **Memory not injected**: make sure `dsh-agent-instructions` is enabled
- **Rules look outdated**: `AGENTS.md` should carry `<!-- dswm:rules v=2 -->` near the top. When missing, the plugin asks your agent to merge the new rules in the next session (it backs up `AGENTS.md.bak-<date>` first)
- **Rollback**: the vault is a git repo — `git -C ~/.dsh/workspace log` / `git -C ~/.dsh/workspace reset --hard <commit>`

```bash
node --check lib/index.js
```

Package layout: `lib/index.js` (sync + hooks), `assets/` (AGENTS.md / memory-log / skills-about templates), `skills/memory-query/`. Distribution uses the DSH bundle model (`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`).

<details>
<summary>liangshen / Anchored Standard — memory is not auto-loaded</summary>

Both modes clear the runtime context on the first turn and keep only your direct message, which **suppresses the automatic `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` injection** performed by `dsh-agent-instructions`. DSWM's index and rules rely on that injection, so memory is not loaded at the start of a session.

This is not a bug — it is the deliberate design of anchored modes (anchor the reasoning trace with minimal context). Just ask the agent to read the file when you need memory:

- `read ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md first, then start`
- or `follow the memory rules in AGENTS.md`
- liangshen can also read it manually after the first block is anchored ("we can" mode); from then on DSWM behaves normally
- Other sessions (non-anchored) are unaffected

</details>

- The placement test moved from "does the memory contain tool-specific identifiers" to "what are you doing when you read it": runtime facts → `reference/skills/`, patch / upgrade / troubleshooting notes → `reference/` (DSH plugins at the top level). Identifiers are now a hint, not the test.
- Why: plugin patches, config keys and build gotchas are full of `code` / `id` / parameter names, so the old test filed them under per-tool memory — yet nobody reads them when *using* the plugin, only when *changing* it.
- Promotion lint now checks both directions (`skills/` ↔ `reference/`) instead of a one-way check with a plugin exception; rule 6 adds "before changing / upgrading / uninstalling a plugin, read the plugin's index entries, not `skills/`".
- Template and `skills-about.md` synced; the rules marker moves to `<!-- dswm:rules v=3 -->`, so v2 users get one merge prompt on their next session (bilingual change summary).
- Compatibility unchanged: still verified against DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (only the rule-version check and hint text changed in code).
